iTunes Store. New Music Tuesday
http://phobos.apple.com/WebObjects/MZStore.woa/wa/com.apple.jingle.app.store.DirectAction/switchToStoreFront?storeFrontId=143441


George Strait
George Strait's signature honky tonk sound has earned him more gold and platinum albums in the United States than any other country artist, and "King George" looks to continue this tradition with his latest release, Troubadour. Pre-order his upcoming album today on iTunes and the set's title track will download instantly.
http://phobos.apple.com/WebObjects/MZStore.woa/wa/viewPreorder?id=275795217&v0=US_NMT_031108&s=143441

New Pornographers
Our latest iTunes-exclusive Live from SoHo session comes via Canadian indie rock band the New Pornographers. The eleven-track set highlights songs from the band's latest effort Challengers, plus a special cover of ELO's "Don't Bring Me Down." 
http://phobos.apple.com/WebObjects/MZStore.woa/wa/viewAlbum?playlistId=274796471&v0=US_NMT_031108&s=143441

Dave Clark 5
You might not remember every song by the Dave Clark Five, but the English beat group was the second band of the "British Invasion" to have a chart hit in the United States with "Glad All Over," and charted eight more Top 10 hits before disbanding in 1970. iTunes celebrates the band's recent induction into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame with The Dave Clark Five: The Hits, an iTunes-exclusive collection available today. 
http://phobos.apple.com/WebObjects/MZStore.woa/wa/viewAlbum?playlistId=275399017&v0=US_NMT_031108&s=143441

St. Patrick's Day Essentials
iTunes is proud to present iTunes Essentials: St. Patrick's Day. From Blarney Stone kisses to tear-in-your-green-beer laments, we're celebrating the Emerald Isle with 21 handpicked playlists. Whether you explore key tracks from the Frames, Van Morrison, U2, and the Pogues, or delve into Irish Folk and Traditional Celtic Music, let us guide you through the Basics, Next Steps, and Deep Cuts of essential St. Patrick's Day music.
http://phobos.apple.com/WebObjects/MZStore.woa/wa/viewRoom?fcId=275388377&id=1&v0=US_NMT_031108&s=143441

Single of the Week
"Rehab." "Crazy." "Gold Digger." Each year, we're graced with a song that's so new, so different -- so darn good -- that it takes ages before it grows tired on your iPod. We think we've found "that" hit for 2008 with Duffy's "Mercy." Armed with a soulful voice reminiscent of Dusty Springfield and some devastatingly good looks, the Welsh siren went straight to the top of the charts in the U.K. and is our free Single of the Week.
